t: Dynamically Darken a Color in CSS - Jim Nielsen’s Blog
s: :root { --color-highlight: 255, 0, 0; } a { color: rgb(var(--color-highlight)); } a:hover { filter: brightness(0.6); } Granted that will change the entire appearance of the element, but for this particular use case, it worked perfect for me. I got a darker color on hover without having to add more color declarations, just what I wanted.
